title: Provenance Node: xvi. a transfiguration (2004)
creator: Ichabod Spellings (author at composition); Lee Sharks (archivist/current attribution)
description:
An archival provenance node preserving and interpreting two early documents associated with *xvi. a transfiguration*: a completed 57-page poem composed in 2003–2004 by Ichabod Spellings and a guide/draft document archived by Lee Sharks.

The record describes a four-part movement through Purgatorio, Nightfall, Final Hour, and Daybreak; a 2004 “Guide for the Perplexed”; earlier draft material; and intertexts including Sappho, Ginsberg, Dante, and Caedmon. It retrospectively interprets the poem as a proto-form of later operative-semiotic and Crimson Hexagon architecture, and identifies a name migration through which Rebekah Cranes becomes legible as a later heteronymic figure. These are archival and hermeneutic findings, not proof that the young author consciously designed the later system.
